sentence: This project builds robots with legs that grip submerged pipes so they can clean and inspect them.
This project uses robotic chemistry to test many conditions for making copolymers that contain olefins.
This project builds an AI tool that uses satellite and drone images to suggest causes of ecosystem changes, tested on detecting submerged aquatic vegetation.
This project builds a tool that adds a phosphate group to proteins as they are made, and tests it in Arabidopsis plants.
This project finds which parts of transcription factors turn genes on in Arabidopsis and builds synthetic transcription factors for other plants.
This project studies how avian influenza spreads and changes genetically, and which factors in the environment drive this.
This project builds software that predicts the structure of organic molecular crystals from a chemical diagram and checks it with experiments.
This project tests whether mixing a weak beam of light with a strong one in an optical amplifier can lower detector noise.
This project builds sensors made of nanomaterials to monitor pollutants and the quality of soil, water and air.
This project explores materials for saving, storing or producing energy, such as sodium-ion batteries and thermoelectrics.
This project studies how platinum compounds disturb the nucleolus in cells and block the making of ribosomes.
This project studies how flexing soft polymer materials can make them generate electricity.
This project studies equations for systems whose future depends on their past, and applies them to ecology and infectious diseases.
This project measures silicon isotopes in the oldest fossils of sponges and radiolarians to find when organisms began building skeletons from silica.
This project studies how to create entanglement between arrays of atoms and light.
This project builds a system using blockchain and federated learning to monitor the condition of wind turbines in rural areas securely.
This project builds computer methods that read long documents and turn the events in them into a knowledge graph.
This project builds Ising machines from simple electronic circuits called latches to solve hard computing problems quickly.
This project uses deep learning to build faster surrogate models of ice sheets so researchers can explore many possible futures for sea level rise.
